prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
An angular lightning-like mark — a single bold zig-zag stroke, no
gradient.
formatted_prompt: Flat bold app icon centered on an off-white (#E7E3D5) canvas with generous padding, modern UI vector register. A single angular zigzag lightning bolt, rendered as one crisp filled shape in vivid burnt sienna (#D97742), thick stroke weight converted to solid geometry, sharp pointed vertices, clean hard edges. The bolt descends at a steep diagonal with two decisive angular breaks — a classic chevron-stepped silhouette. No interior detail, no gradient, no texture, no brushwork. Secondary deep navy (#0B0F14) background square with rounded corners frames the bolt, maximizing contrast. Fully readable at 16px. Flat, sharp, 2026-era icon design.
